task.description:
Design the implementation for TNT-01 through TNT-04 — the schema-per-tenant isolation foundation for Stage 12.

TNT-01: All business tables must live in per-tenant PostgreSQL schemas (tenant_<uuid>), not in public.
TNT-02: Migration runner must set search_path = <tenant_schema>, public before executing any migration SQL. A CI linter must reject migrations that reference public.<business_table>.
TNT-03: Connection pool must set search_path = <tenant_schema>, public on checkout and reset to public on connection return. search_path must be re-applied after reconnect.
TNT-04: Platform startup must audit public schema and log ERROR for any unexpected tables (permitted list: tenant, tenant_schemas, tenant_hostnames, tenant_realm_binding, schema_migrations, onboarding_registry, service_catalog, repository_artifacts, repository_activations, alerting_state).

Classify each requirement against templates/lego-catalog.md. These are novel cross-cutting changes — likely Type E (prose design). Produce:
- src/design/tnt-01-04-schema-isolation.md: full design artefact covering:
  * Per-tenant schema provisioning: how/when tenant schemas are created (during onboarding)
  * Migration runner changes: src/identity/onboarding.zig or dedicated migrations module — how search_path is set per-tenant
  * CI linter: tools/lint_migration_schema.py — regex patterns for business table references
  * Connection pool changes: src/db/pool.zig (or equivalent) — checkout/return search_path lifecycle
  * Startup schema audit: src/bootstrap/audit.zig (or equivalent) — query information_schema, compare against permitted list, log ERROR/INFO
  * Public signature list for all modified functions
  * Error taxonomy for all new failure modes
  * Migration file needed: creates tenant schema on provisioning, no public business tables
  * Dependencies on existing modules (onboarding, pool, bootstrap)

Do NOT write implementation code. Design only.

REWORK 1 (from CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR):
- [BLOCKER] TNT-03 no-tenant case: the design specifies that when tenant_context_mod.get() returns empty string, applyRequestTenantContext uses schemaNameForTenant which returns tenant_default, causing SET search_path TO tenant_default,public — this violates TNT-03 AC: no-tenant requests MUST get SET search_path TO public only (no tenant schema prefix). Fix: applyRequestTenantContext must branch on empty/no-tenant input and issue SET search_path TO public without any tenant schema prefix. The schemaNameForTenant helper may still return tenant_default for provisioning purposes, but the pool checkout path must treat empty tenant_id as public-only.
acceptance_criteria: src/design/tnt-01-04-schema-isolation.md exists and covers all acceptance criteria for TNT-01, TNT-02, TNT-03, TNT-04
Every public function modified or added has its signature listed
Error taxonomy covers all new failure modes
Migration runner search_path protocol is specified precisely (which SQL statement, when, on which connection)
Connection pool checkout/return search_path lifecycle is fully specified
Startup audit query and permitted table list are specified
CI linter patterns for public.<business_table> are enumerated
No implementation code (function bodies, SQL bodies) in the design artefact
python tools/lint_design_artefact.py src/design/tnt-01-04-schema-isolation.md exits 0 with no BLOCKER/MAJOR

result.summary: Fixed TNT-03 no-tenant case in applyRequestTenantContext: empty tenant_id now issues SET search_path TO public only (no tenant schema prefix). Updated function signature spec, checkout sequence branching, no-tenant case section, key invariants, and traceability notes for consistency.
